judged_text: Team-permission DB queries at `addGuests.handler.ts:46-48` run before the free checks: `isTeamAdmin` is awaited, then (if true) `isTeamOwner`, before the pure in-memory `isOrganizer`/`isAttendee` checks — wasting 1-2 membership queries in the common organizer/attendee path, and they also fire with `teamId ?? 0` for personal (non-team) bookings; reorder to check organizer/attendee first.

record.issue_text: Team-permission DB queries at `addGuests.handler.ts:46-48` run before the free checks: `isTeamAdmin` is awaited, then (if true) `isTeamOwner`, before the pure in-memory `isOrganizer`/`isAttendee` checks — wasting 1-2 membership queries in the common organizer/attendee path, and they also fire with `teamId ?? 0` for personal (non-team) bookings; reorder to check organizer/attendee first.

adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the permission check computes `isTeamAdminOrOwner` via awaited `isTeamAdmin(user.id, booking.eventType?.teamId ?? 0)` (and potentially `isTeamOwner(...)`) before computing the in-memory `isOrganizer` (`booking.userId === user.id`) and `isAttendee` (`booking.attendees.find(...)`). This ordering can cause an unnecessary DB membership query (and sometimes a second) even when the user is clearly the organizer/attendee, and it also runs with `teamId ?? 0` for non-team bookings, which may trigger pointless queries. This is a concrete efficiency/architecture concern, not a functional defect shown by the diff.
